code:
# Conceptual shape of an Azure Budget
Amount: $10,000 / month
Scope: subscription, filtered by tag team=payments
Thresholds:
  80% -> action group: email + webhook
  100% -> action group: email + Azure Function
caption: Scoped the same way Cost Analysis is — a team can own a budget for just its own tagged spend.

steps.label: Cost budget
steps.sub: A dollar threshold over a time period — Azure Budget's direct equivalent

steps.label: Usage / coverage budget
steps.sub: Tracks usage units, or Savings Plans/RI coverage percentage

steps.label: Actual vs. forecasted
steps.sub: A forecasted threshold can alert before the month even ends

code:
# AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitor (conceptual)
Monitor scope: service | linked account | cost allocation tag
Detection: ML-based, learned from historical spend
Alert includes: top contributor service/resource

# Azure Cost Management anomaly detection works the same way —
# enabled per subscription, no manual threshold required
caption: No threshold to set — both flag a day's spend that deviates from the account's own learned pattern.
